briefdescription.para: Server Module Hardening — Phase 1 focused regression tests.

detaileddescription.para: Covers comprehensive retry semantics, timeout edge cases, graceful shutdown ordering, fault recovery, and chaos/failure injection per Phase 1 specification.

listitem.para: SRV-09..16: Timeout edge cases (pre-timeout, at-timeout, post-timeout)
SRV-17..24: Graceful shutdown ordering (clean drain, forced shutdown)
SRV-25..31: Fault-recovery scenarios (transient errors, permanent errors)

detaileddescription.para: All 39 tests use deterministic seed 42, in-process infrastructure, and std::chrono::steady_clock for timing validation.
